general.title: Project settings · acme/backend-api · Woodpecker
general.target_text:
Project settings

Configure supported repository behavior, execution policy, visibility, approval, and trust controls.

Pipeline behavior

Control supported triggers, deployment access, visibility, and approval requirements.

Allow Pull Requests
Allow the execution of pipelines on pull requests.
Allow Deployments
Allow deployments for successful pipelines. All users with push permissions can trigger these, so use with caution.
Project visibility
Public
Anyone can see your project without being logged in.
Internal
Only authenticated users of the Woodpecker instance can see this project.
Private
Only you and other owners of the repository can see this project.
Approval requirements
Prevent malicious pipelines from exposing secrets or running harmful tasks by approving them before execution.
None
Every event triggers pipelines, including pull requests. This setting can be dangerous and is only recommended for private instances.
Pull request from forked repository
All pull requests
All events from forge
Allowed users
Pipelines created by the listed users never require approval.
Execution policy

Configure timeout, pipeline path, and cancellation behavior using current repository fields.

Timeout
minutes
Pipeline path
Path to your pipeline config (for example my/path/). Folders should end with a /.
Cancel previous pipelines
Selected event triggers cancel pending and running pipelines of the same event before starting the next one.
Push
Tag
Pull Request
Deploy
Trust and credentials

Limit clone credentials and administrator-only privileged pipeline capabilities.

Custom trusted clone plugins
Plugins that get access to netrc credentials that can be used to clone repositories from the forge or push them into the forge.
Trusted
Network
Pipeline containers get access to network privileges like changing DNS.
Volumes
Pipeline containers are allowed to mount volumes.
Security
Pipeline containers get access to security privileges.
Save settings
